1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having a plurality of conductive paths formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the conductive paths configured to provide electrical connection between an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, __wherein the opening is formed through a solder mask layer disposed on the packaging structure__; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the packaging structure via at least one of a dielectric bonding agent or a conductive bonding agent__.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Cancelled)

4. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure __is a ring structure that__ extends above the chip mounting surface.

5. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer, __and wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a sidewall of the opening__.

6. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 5, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer, __and wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with the core layer__.

7. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising: an integrated circuit chip mounted on the chip mounting surface, __wherein the stiffening microstructure includes a lid__.

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 7 further comprising: a heat transfer medium providing a thermally conductive pathway between the lid and the integrated circuit chip, __wherein the heat transfer medium is disposed between the lid and the integrated circuit chip__.

10. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1, wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring __structure disposed in the opening and extending into the packaging structure__.

11. (Cancelled)

12. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a dielectric bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure, __wherein the dielectric bonding agent is disposed between the stiffening microstructure and at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening__.

13. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 1 further comprising a conductive bonding agent coupling the stiffening microstructure to the packaging structure, __wherein the conductive bonding agent is in contact with a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure__.

14. (Currently amended) A computing device, comprising: a memory; and a packaged semiconductor device communicatively coupled to the memory, wherein the packaged semiconductor device comprises: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, __wherein the opening is formed through a solder mask layer disposed on the packaging structure__; an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and communicatively coupled to the memory through the packaging structure; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the packaging structure via at least one of a dielectric bonding agent or a conductive bonding agent__.

15. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface and a sidewall of the opening, __and wherein the stiffening microstructure is a ring structure__.

16. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure __is a ring structure that__ extends above the chip mounting surface.

17. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the chip mounting surface is on a solder mask layer, and the opening extends through the solder mask layer, __and wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to a sidewall of the opening__.

18. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 17, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a core layer disposed below the solder mask layer, the opening exposing a portion of the core layer, __and wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with the core layer__.

19. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the stiffening microstructure __includes at least one of a ring or a lid, and wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the packaging structure via at least one of a dielectric bonding agent or a conductive bonding agent__.

20. (Currently amended) The packaging substrate of claim 14, wherein the packaging structure further comprises: a ground reference plane layer disposed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface of the packaging structure, wherein the stiffening microstructure is in contact with the ground reference plane layer, __and wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to the packaging structure via a conductive bonding agent__.
